evidence: Contamination scan: grep -i for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|lorem|drive-letter paths|/Users/|/home/|Documents|turing|author|claude|judge|rubric|criteri over task/instruction.md, environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md and integration.md returned zero hits. The template placeholder 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt the agent receives.' is fully replaced. Every path in the brief is a container path the task defines (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md); there are no host or other-machine paths. Spelling: I extracted all 640 distinct words across the three files and read through them. No misspellings; the only unusual tokens are proper names (Haddad, Halvorsen, Okafor, Sorensen...), 'Hireops!2026' (the password, deliberately written that way and consistent in instruction.md:17 and hireops_rules.md:11) and 'undoable'/'overfill' (valid words). No doubled words, and no paragraph appears twice. Contradiction cross-check: the 10 accounts and roles in instruction.md:17 exactly match seed users (3 recruiter, 3 hiring_manager, 1 observer, 3 candidate). Port 3000/PORT, /api/health, /app/app.db/DB_PATH, server.js, and seed path agree across instruction.md:13-15, integration.md:3-10 and hireops_rules.md:198-209. 'fifteen seconds' (instruction.md:5) = '15 seconds' (rules:117). The 'one stage at a time', all-or-none bulk move, undo, draft and candidate-visibility promises in instruction.md:3-9 agree with rules sections 3, 6 and 7. The candidate wording table (rules:183-190) matches seed candidate_status_labels, and the page size of 30 (rules:144) matches seed thread_page_size=30. The activity example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' (rules:111) uses real seed people, and Priya Nair (APP-103) is in SCREEN, so the example is plausible. Seed generated_note ('Starting data exported from the recruiting desk...') reads as an in-world note, not an author aside. Attempted counterexamples: (a) a reader could take 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since' (instruction.md:3) to include adding a note, but rules:99 explicitly disambiguates ('Adding a note does not count as a change'), so this is a refinement, not a contradiction. (b) rules:3 says 'Routes ... are yours' while instruction.md:13 fixes GET /api/health. instruction.md:13 scopes the freedom to 'the other files and routes', so a careful reader finds no conflict. (c) A conforming app could not be failed by any text defect found here. Minor, non-defect observations (Note level, no grading impact): mixed British/American spelling ('honour'/'honouring' in instruction.md:13 vs 'Honor'/'honoring' in rules:201 and integration.md:8); hard-wrap seams in hireops_rules.md at lines 91-92 (short break) and 99, 112, 173, 180 (overlong lines of 111-169 chars), which show the text was spliced in editing but render as normal Markdown paragraphs; integration.md adds lines 16-19 (symlink/NODE_PATH delivery rule) beyond the template copy, and this is consistent with 'don't install packages'. Template preservation of that file belongs to other rows, not this one. This row is a text-hygiene check that needs no runtime measurement. Its Pass does not imply anything about runtime, Oracle or portal results.
